model_annotations.Bulgarian: Figure 5 illustrates the training curves for SRPO and Clean RL, comparing their performance over time. The horizontal axis represents the training steps, ranging from 0 to 500, with evenly spaced increments of 50. The vertical axis on the left displays the reward, ranging from 0 to 1, with increments of 0.1. The vertical axis on the right shows the surface area, ranging from 0 to 300, with increments of 50. Two lines are plotted: one for SRPO (orange) and one for Clean RL (blue). The SRPO line starts at a reward of approximately 0.1 and increases to a peak of around 0.95 at approximately 450 training steps, before slightly decreasing to around 0.9 at 500 steps. The surface area for SRPO increases from approximately 20 to 280 over the 500 training steps. The Clean RL line starts at a reward of approximately 0.05 and increases to a peak of around 0.85 at approximately 400 training steps, before slightly decreasing to around 0.8 at 500 steps. The surface area for Clean RL increases from approximately 10 to 250 over the 500 training steps. A shaded region surrounds the SRPO line, indicating the standard deviation.
model_annotations.Chinese: The figure presents three line graphs illustrating training curves for SRPO (Self-Reflection and Refinement) and generated samples during RL training. The horizontal axis, labeled "Train/Response Length," spans from 0 to 500, with linear scale increments of 100. The vertical axis, labeled "Reward," ranges from 0 to 1, with linear scale increments of 0.1. The first graph, titled "Train," displays a single orange line, starting at approximately 0.01 and rising to a maximum value of around 0.95 at a length of 400, before slightly decreasing to approximately 0.90 at 500. The second graph, titled "Response Length," shows a single blue line, beginning at approximately 0.01 and increasing to a maximum value of around 0.98 at a length of 300, then decreasing to approximately 0.90 at 500. The third graph, titled "Clip Upper," features a single green line, starting at approximately 0.01 and reaching a maximum value of around 0.99 at a length of 200, before decreasing to approximately 0.90 at 500. All three graphs are presented without any specific sorting or visual emphasis on particular data points.
model_annotations.English: Figure 5 illustrates the Train/Response Length distributions for SRPO and clean training samples, alongside Train/Self-reflection Length distributions for SRPO and clean training samples, and Train/Response Length distributions for SRPO and real test case samples. The horizontal axis in all three subplots represents Train/Response Length, ranging from 0 to 500 with tick labels at intervals of 100. The vertical axis in all three subplots represents the frequency, ranging from 0 to 1 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The first subplot displays the distribution of SRPO training samples (orange) and clean training samples (blue). The second subplot displays the distribution of SRPO self-reflection samples (orange) and clean training samples (blue). The third subplot displays the distribution of SRPO training samples (orange) and real test case samples (blue). All bars are of uniform width and are not sorted in any particular order; no bars are visually emphasized.
model_annotations.German: Die Abbildung 5 zeigt drei Balkendiagramme, die die Trainings- und Testleistung von SRPQ- und GRPO-Modellen darstellen. Das erste Balkendiagramm, mit der Beschriftung "Training curves for SRPQ and Clean", stellt die Trainings- und Testleistung von SRPQ-Modellen dar, wobei die horizontale Achse die Trainings-Epochen (von 0 bis 40) und die vertikale Achse die Leistung (von 0 bis 1) darstellt. Die Trainingskurve ist in Orange dargestellt und zeigt einen Wert von etwa 0,6 bei Epoche 0 und steigt auf etwa 0,98 bei Epoche 40 an. Die Testkurve ist in Blau dargestellt und beginnt bei etwa 0,5 bei Epoche 0 und erreicht etwa 0,95 bei Epoche 40. Das zweite Balkendiagramm, mit der Beschriftung "Training curves for GRPO", stellt die Trainings- und Testleistung von GRPO-Modellen dar, wobei die horizontale Achse die Trainings-Epochen (von 0 bis 40) und die vertikale Achse die Leistung (von 0 bis 1) darstellt. Die Trainingskurve ist in Orange dargestellt und beginnt bei etwa 0,5 bei Epoche 0 und steigt auf etwa 0,97 bei Epoche 40 an. Die Testkurve ist in Blau dargestellt und beginnt bei etwa 0,4 bei Epoche 0 und erreicht etwa 0,96 bei Epoche 40. Das dritte Balkendiagramm, mit der Beschriftung "Train/Response Length", stellt die Trainings- und Antwortlänge dar, wobei die horizontale Achse die Trainings-Epochen (von 0 bis 40) und die vertikale Achse die Antwortlänge (von 0 bis 500) darstellt. Die Trainingskurve ist in Orange dargestellt und beginnt bei etwa 100 bei Epoche 0 und sinkt auf etwa 50 bei Epoche 40 ab. Die Testkurve ist in Blau dargestellt und beginnt bei etwa 150 bei Epoche 0 und sinkt auf etwa 75 bei Epoche 40 ab.
